items.question: Got a weird email asking me to confirm my login details. What should I do?
items.search_query: Got a weird email asking me to confirm my login details. What should I do?
items.answer: First, check if the email has any signs of phishing, such as suspicious sender addresses or urgent language [1]. items.question: I deleted a spreadsheet by mistake yesterday, can I get it back?
items.search_query: I deleted a spreadsheet by mistake yesterday, can I get it back?
items.answer: You can restore the deleted spreadsheet by following these steps: 1. Open OneDrive. 2. Click on the Recycle Bin on the left sidebar. 3. Find the spreadsheet you want to restore and select it. 4. Click on the Restore button to recover it. [1]

items.question: My Teams mic is dead during calls, what should I check?
items.search_query: My Teams mic is dead during calls, what should I check?
items.answer: Check that your microphone is connected and not muted. Go to Settings > Devices in Teams to select the correct microphone and test it [1].

items.answer: To report the issue of too much tax deducted from your payslip, gather supporting documents and use the ‘Report Issue’ option in PeopleHub to report the discrepancy. Follow the steps outlined in the payroll corrections section to submit your request for review. [1]
